noun_definition: Data copy is a duplicate of a data structure that maintains the original data's values and organization.
noun_functionality: The function creates a deep copy of the input data, ensuring that any transformations applied do not affect the original data structure.

noun_definition: Copy action is the process of duplicating selected content to the clipboard for later use.
noun_functionality: The function sets up a keyboard shortcut to trigger the copy action, allowing users to copy selected content to the clipboard.

noun_definition: Sign In Hero Copy is the textual content displayed in the sign-in interface, typically including a headline and body text.
noun_functionality: The function retrieves and displays customizable headline and body text for the sign-in hero section, allowing for localization and default text fallback.

noun_definition: Copy to clipboard is a functionality that allows users to duplicate text or data to the system clipboard for pasting elsewhere.
noun_functionality: The function handles the action of copying the card number (PAN) to the clipboard when the user interacts with the corresponding UI element.

noun_definition: A reservation is an arrangement made in advance to secure a service or accommodation, such as a flight, hotel, or car rental.
noun_functionality: The function handles the display and formatting of reservation details, including the type of reservation, associated dates, and relevant company or location information.

noun_definition: Plain text paste is the action of inserting text data without any formatting from the clipboard into a target interface.
noun_functionality: The function reads plain text from the clipboard and inserts it into the specified browser window's content.

noun_definition: A clipboard paste event is an action that occurs when content is inserted into an application from the clipboard.
noun_functionality: The function handles the paste event by checking for file attachments or HTML content, converting pasted HTML to Markdown, and invoking the appropriate callback functions for file management or content insertion.

noun_definition: Clipboard paste is the action of inserting content from the clipboard into a text input field.
noun_functionality: The function handles the pasting of files from the clipboard, extracting relevant information such as the file URI and its type, and then triggering a callback with the file object.
